local output = {}
local compile_only = {}
local interpret_only = {[":"] = true, [":NONAME"] = true, FORGET = true}
local both_modes = {['."'] = true, ["("] = true, ["\\"] = true, TO = true, IS = true}
for name in ('IF ELSE THEN DO ?DO LOOP +LOOP LEAVE UNLOOP I J BEGIN UNTIL WHILE REPEAT AGAIN CASE OF ENDOF ENDCASE EXIT RECURSE DOES> ; >R R> R@ ABORT" [\'] {:'):gmatch(
    "%S+"
) do
    compile_only[name] = true
end
local builtin_names =
    "+ - * / MOD /MOD */ */MOD NEGATE ABS MIN MAX 1+ 1- 2* 2/ = <> < > 0= 0<> 0< 0> WITHIN TRUE FALSE AND OR XOR INVERT DUP ?DUP DROP SWAP OVER ROT -ROT NIP TUCK 2DUP 2DROP 2SWAP 2OVER DEPTH PICK ROLL . .R .S ? CR EMIT SPACE SPACES BL ! @ +! , ALLOT HERE CELLS CELL+ BASE HEX DECIMAL CREATE VARIABLE CONSTANT VALUE DEFER ' EXECUTE CATCH THROW ABORT WORDS"
local function problem(word, reason, code)
    error({forth = true, word = word, reason = reason, code = code}, 0)
end
local function syntax(word, reason)
    problem(word, reason)
end
local function flag(value)
    return value and -1 or 0
end
local function copy(list)
    local result = {}
    for i, value in ipairs(list) do
        result[i] = value
    end
    return result
end

local Machine = {}
Machine.__index = Machine
function Machine.new()
    local self =
        setmetatable(
        {
            data = {},
            returns = {},
            memory = {10},
            dictionary = {},
            builtins = {},
            tokens = {},
            token_numbers = {},
            controls = {},
            depth = 0,
            pending = ""
        },
        Machine
    )
    for name in builtin_names:gmatch("%S+") do
        self.builtins[name] = {name = name, kind = "builtin"}
    end
    return self
end
function Machine:read()
    while self.position <= #self.line and self.line:sub(self.position, self.position) == " " do
        self.position = self.position + 1
    end
    local start = self.position
    while self.position <= #self.line and self.line:sub(self.position, self.position) ~= " " do
        self.position = self.position + 1
    end
    if start == self.position then
        return nil
    end
    return self.line:sub(start, self.position - 1)
end
function Machine:read_name(raw)
    local name = self:read()
    if not name then
        problem(raw, "missing name", -16)
    end
    return name
end
function Machine:lookup(name)
    name = name:upper()
    for i = #self.dictionary, 1, -1 do
        if self.dictionary[i].name == name then
            return self.dictionary[i]
        end
    end
    return self.builtins[name]
end
function Machine:numeric(raw, base)
    if #raw == 3 and raw:sub(1, 1) == "'" and raw:sub(3, 3) == "'" then
        return raw:byte(2)
    end
    local text, first = raw:upper(), raw:sub(1, 1)
    if first == "$" then
        base, text = 16, text:sub(2)
    elseif first == "#" then
        base, text = 10, text:sub(2)
    elseif first == "%" then
        base, text = 2, text:sub(2)
    elseif base < 2 or base > 36 then
        problem(raw, "invalid base", -40)
    end
    local negative = text:sub(1, 1) == "-"
    if negative then
        text = text:sub(2)
    end
    if text == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local digits = {}
    for i = 1, #text do
        local c, digit = text:byte(i), -1
        if c >= 48 and c <= 57 then
            digit = c - 48
        elseif c >= 65 and c <= 90 then
            digit = c - 65 + 10
        end
        if digit < 0 or digit >= base then
            return nil
        end
        digits[i] = digit
    end
    local value = 0
    for _, digit in ipairs(digits) do
        value = value * base + digit
    end
    return negative and -value or value
end
function Machine:check_name(raw)
    local name = raw:upper()
    if
        compile_only[name] or interpret_only[name] or both_modes[name] or
            self:numeric(raw, 10) ~= nil
     then
        problem(raw, "invalid name", -19)
    end
end
function Machine:take(count, raw)
    if #self.data < count then
        problem(raw, "stack underflow", -4)
    end
    local result, start = {}, #self.data - count
    for i = 1, count do
        result[i] = self.data[start + i]
    end
    for i = #self.data, start + 1, -1 do
        self.data[i] = nil
    end
    return result
end
function Machine:push(value, raw)
    self.data[#self.data + 1] = value
    if #self.data > 1000 then
        problem(raw, "stack overflow", -3)
    end
end
function Machine:return_need(count, raw)
    if #self.returns < count then
        problem(raw, "return stack underflow", -6)
    end
end
function Machine:return_push(value, raw)
    self.returns[#self.returns + 1] = value
    if #self.returns > 1000 then
        problem(raw, "return stack overflow", -5)
    end
end
function Machine:address(value, raw)
    if value < 0 or value % 8 ~= 0 or value >= #self.memory * 8 then
        problem(raw, "invalid address", -9)
    end
    return value // 8 + 1
end
function Machine:format(value, raw)
    local base = self.memory[1]
    if base < 2 or base > 36 then
        problem(raw, "invalid base", -40)
    end
    local negative, digits = value < 0, "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    if negative then
        value = -value
    end
    local result = ""
    repeat
        local digit = value % base
        result = digits:sub(digit + 1, digit + 1) .. result
        value = value // base
    until value == 0
    return (negative and "-" or "") .. result
end
function Machine:write(text)
    self.pending = self.pending .. text
end
function Machine:flush()
    output[#output + 1] = self.pending:gsub(" +$", "")
    self.pending = ""
end
function Machine:execution_token(word)
    if not self.token_numbers[word] then
        self.tokens[#self.tokens + 1] = word
        self.token_numbers[word] = #self.tokens
    end
    return self.token_numbers[word]
end
function Machine:valid_token(value, raw)
    if value < 1 or value > #self.tokens then
        problem(raw, "invalid argument", -24)
    end
    return self.tokens[value]
end
function Machine:execute_token(value, raw)
    local word = self:valid_token(value, raw)
    self:execute(word, word.name)
end
function Machine:add_action(action)
    self.compiling.actions[#self.compiling.actions + 1] = action
    return #self.compiling.actions
end
function Machine:top_control(raw, ...)
    local top = self.controls[#self.controls]
    for _, kind in ipairs({...}) do
        if top and top.kind == kind then
            return top
        end
    end
    syntax(raw, "control structure mismatch")
end
function Machine:compile_control(raw, name)
    if name == "IF" then
        self.controls[#self.controls + 1] = {
            kind = "IF",
            index = self:add_action({kind = "zero", raw = raw})
        }
    elseif name == "ELSE" then
        local top = self:top_control(raw, "IF")
        local index = self:add_action({kind = "jump", raw = raw})
        self.compiling.actions[top.index].target = #self.compiling.actions + 1
        top.kind, top.index = "ELSE", index
    elseif name == "THEN" then
        local top = self:top_control(raw, "IF", "ELSE")
        self.compiling.actions[top.index].target = #self.compiling.actions + 1
        table.remove(self.controls)
    elseif name == "BEGIN" then
        self.controls[#self.controls + 1] = {kind = "BEGIN", start = #self.compiling.actions + 1}
    elseif name == "UNTIL" or name == "AGAIN" then
        local top = self:top_control(raw, "BEGIN")
        self:add_action(
            {kind = name == "UNTIL" and "zero" or "jump", raw = raw, target = top.start}
        )
        table.remove(self.controls)
    elseif name == "WHILE" then
        local top = self:top_control(raw, "BEGIN")
        top.kind, top.index = "WHILE", self:add_action({kind = "zero", raw = raw})
    elseif name == "REPEAT" then
        local top = self:top_control(raw, "WHILE")
        self:add_action({kind = "jump", raw = raw, target = top.start})
        self.compiling.actions[top.index].target = #self.compiling.actions + 1
        table.remove(self.controls)
    elseif name == "DO" or name == "?DO" then
        local index = self:add_action({kind = name, raw = raw})
        self.controls[#self.controls + 1] = {
            kind = name,
            index = index,
            start = index + 1,
            leaves = {}
        }
    elseif name == "LOOP" or name == "+LOOP" then
        local top = self:top_control(raw, "DO", "?DO")
        self:add_action({kind = name, raw = raw, target = top.start})
        local finish = #self.compiling.actions + 1
        self.compiling.actions[top.index].target = finish
        for _, index in ipairs(top.leaves) do
            self.compiling.actions[index].target = finish
        end
        table.remove(self.controls)
    elseif name == "LEAVE" then
        local top
        for i = #self.controls, 1, -1 do
            if self.controls[i].kind == "DO" or self.controls[i].kind == "?DO" then
                top = self.controls[i]
                break
            end
        end
        if not top then
            syntax(raw, "control structure mismatch")
        end
        top.leaves[#top.leaves + 1] = self:add_action({kind = "LEAVE", raw = raw})
    elseif name == "CASE" then
        self.controls[#self.controls + 1] = {kind = "CASE", ends = {}}
    elseif name == "OF" then
        self:top_control(raw, "CASE")
        self.controls[#self.controls + 1] = {
            kind = "OF",
            index = self:add_action({kind = "OF", raw = raw})
        }
    elseif name == "ENDOF" then
        local top = self:top_control(raw, "OF")
        local index = self:add_action({kind = "jump", raw = raw})
        self.compiling.actions[top.index].target = #self.compiling.actions + 1
        table.remove(self.controls)
        local parent = self:top_control(raw, "CASE")
        parent.ends[#parent.ends + 1] = index
    elseif name == "ENDCASE" then
        local top = self:top_control(raw, "CASE")
        self:add_action({kind = "ENDCASE", raw = raw})
        for _, index in ipairs(top.ends) do
            self.compiling.actions[index].target = #self.compiling.actions + 1
        end
        table.remove(self.controls)
    else
        return false
    end
    return true
end
function Machine:read_string(raw)
    if self.position > #self.line then
        syntax(raw, "unterminated string")
    end
    local start = self.position + 1
    local closing = self.line:find('"', start, true)
    if not closing then
        syntax(raw, "unterminated string")
    end
    self.position = closing + 1
    return self.line:sub(start, closing - 1)
end
function Machine:locals(raw)
    local names, ignored, closed = {}, false, false
    while true do
        local name = self:read()
        if not name then
            break
        end
        if name:upper() == ":}" then
            closed = true
            break
        end
        if name == "--" then
            ignored = true
        end
        if not ignored then
            names[#names + 1] = name
        end
    end
    if not closed then
        syntax(raw, "unterminated locals")
    end
    local slots = {}
    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
        self:check_name(name)
        self.compiling.local_count = self.compiling.local_count + 1
        local slot = self.compiling.local_count
        self.compiling.local_names[name:upper()] = slot
        slots[#slots + 1] = slot
    end
    self:add_action({kind = "locals", raw = raw, slots = slots})
end
function Machine:assign(raw, name)
    local target_name = self:read_name(raw)
    if name == "TO" and self.compiling then
        local slot = self.compiling.local_names[target_name:upper()]
        if slot then
            self:add_action({kind = "localSet", raw = raw, target = slot})
            return
        end
    end
    local target = self:lookup(target_name)
    if not target then
        problem(target_name, "undefined word", -13)
    end
    local required, reason =
        name == "TO" and "value" or "defer",
        name == "TO" and "not a value" or "not deferred"
    if target.kind ~= required then
        syntax(target_name, reason)
    end
    local action = {kind = name, raw = raw, word = target}
    if self.compiling then
        self:add_action(action)
    else
        self:runtime_action(action, {})
    end
end
function Machine:process(raw)
    local name = raw:upper()
    if name == "\\" then
        self.position = #self.line + 1
        return
    end
    if name == "(" then
        local closing = self.line:find(")", self.position, true)
        if not closing then
            syntax(raw, "unterminated comment")
        end
        self.position = closing + 1
        return
    end
    if not self.compiling and compile_only[name] then
        syntax(raw, "compile only")
    end
    if self.compiling and interpret_only[name] then
        syntax(raw, "interpret only")
    end
    if name == '."' or name == 'ABORT"' then
        local text = self:read_string(raw)
        if self.compiling then
            self:add_action({kind = name, raw = raw, text = text})
        else
            self:write(text)
        end
        return
    end
    if name == "TO" or name == "IS" then
        self:assign(raw, name)
        return
    end
    if name == ":" or name == ":NONAME" then
        local raw_name = raw
        if name == ":" then
            raw_name = self:read_name(raw)
            self:check_name(raw_name)
        end
        self.compiling = {
            name = name == ":NONAME" and ":NONAME" or raw_name:upper(),
            raw_name = raw_name,
            kind = "colon",
            here = #self.memory * 8,
            actions = {},
            local_names = {},
            local_count = 0
        }
        self.controls = {}
        return
    end
    if name == "FORGET" then
        local target_name, index = self:read_name(raw), nil
        for i = #self.dictionary, 1, -1 do
            if self.dictionary[i].name == target_name:upper() then
                index = i
                break
            end
        end
        if not index then
            problem(target_name, "undefined word", -13)
        end
        for i = #self.memory, self.dictionary[index].here // 8 + 1, -1 do
            self.memory[i] = nil
        end
        for i = #self.dictionary, index, -1 do
            self.dictionary[i] = nil
        end
        return
    end
    if self.compiling then
        if self:compile_control(raw, name) then
            return
        end
        if name == ";" then
            if #self.controls > 0 then
                local kind = self.controls[#self.controls].kind
                if kind == "ELSE" then
                    kind = "IF"
                elseif kind == "WHILE" then
                    kind = "BEGIN"
                end
                syntax(raw, "unclosed " .. kind)
            end
            local finished = self.compiling
            self.compiling = nil
            if finished.name == ":NONAME" then
                self:push(self:execution_token(finished), raw)
            else
                self.dictionary[#self.dictionary + 1] = finished
            end
            return
        elseif name == "DOES>" then
            if #self.controls > 0 then
                syntax(raw, "control structure mismatch")
            end
            self:add_action({kind = "DOES>", raw = raw, word = self.compiling})
            return
        elseif name == "EXIT" then
            self:add_action({kind = "EXIT", raw = raw})
            return
        elseif name == "RECURSE" then
            self:add_action({kind = "call", raw = raw, word = self.compiling})
            return
        elseif name == "[']" then
            local target_name = self:read_name(raw)
            local target = self:lookup(target_name)
            if not target then
                problem(target_name, "undefined word", -13)
            end
            self:add_action({kind = "push", raw = raw, value = self:execution_token(target)})
            return
        elseif name == "{:" then
            self:locals(raw)
            return
        end
        if
            name == ">R" or name == "R>" or name == "R@" or name == "I" or name == "J" or
                name == "UNLOOP"
         then
            self:add_action({kind = name, raw = raw})
            return
        end
        local slot = self.compiling.local_names[name]
        if slot then
            self:add_action({kind = "localGet", raw = raw, target = slot})
            return
        end
        local target = self:lookup(raw)
        if target then
            self:add_action({kind = "call", raw = raw, word = target})
            return
        end
        local value = self:numeric(raw, self.memory[1])
        if value ~= nil then
            self:add_action({kind = "push", raw = raw, value = value})
            return
        end
        problem(raw, "undefined word", -13)
    end
    local target = self:lookup(raw)
    if target then
        self:execute(target, raw)
        return
    end
    local value = self:numeric(raw, self.memory[1])
    if value ~= nil then
        self:push(value, raw)
        return
    end
    problem(raw, "undefined word", -13)
end
function Machine:runtime_action(action, locals)
    local kind, raw = action.kind, action.raw
    if kind == "push" then
        self:push(action.value, raw)
    elseif kind == "call" then
        self:execute(action.word, raw)
    elseif kind == '."' then
        self:write(action.text)
    elseif kind == 'ABORT"' then
        if self:take(1, raw)[1] ~= 0 then
            problem(raw, action.text, -2)
        end
    elseif kind == "localGet" then
        self:push(locals[action.target], raw)
    elseif kind == "localSet" then
        locals[action.target] = self:take(1, raw)[1]
    elseif kind == "locals" then
        local values = self:take(#action.slots, raw)
        for i, slot in ipairs(action.slots) do
            locals[slot] = values[i]
        end
    elseif kind == "TO" then
        self.memory[action.word.address // 8 + 1] = self:take(1, raw)[1]
    elseif kind == "IS" then
        local value = self:take(1, raw)[1]
        self:valid_token(value, raw)
        action.word.token = value
    elseif kind == ">R" then
        self:return_push(self:take(1, raw)[1], raw)
    elseif kind == "R>" then
        self:return_need(1, raw)
        self:push(table.remove(self.returns), raw)
    elseif kind == "R@" or kind == "I" or kind == "J" then
        local count = kind == "J" and 3 or 1
        self:return_need(count, raw)
        self:push(self.returns[#self.returns - count + 1], raw)
    elseif kind == "UNLOOP" then
        self:return_need(2, raw)
        table.remove(self.returns)
        table.remove(self.returns)
    end
end
function Machine:definition(word, start, raw)
    if self.depth == 100 then
        problem(raw, "nesting too deep", -7)
    end
    self.depth = self.depth + 1
    local saved, locals, pc = #self.returns, {}, start
    for i = 1, word.local_count do
        locals[i] = 0
    end
    while pc <= #word.actions do
        local action = word.actions[pc]
        pc = pc + 1
        local kind = action.kind
        if kind == "EXIT" then
            break
        elseif kind == "DOES>" then
            local newest = self.dictionary[#self.dictionary]
            if not newest or newest.kind ~= "create" then
                problem(action.raw, "no CREATE word", -31)
            end
            newest.does, newest.does_start = action.word, pc
            break
        elseif kind == "jump" then
            pc = action.target
        elseif kind == "zero" then
            if self:take(1, action.raw)[1] == 0 then
                pc = action.target
            end
        elseif kind == "DO" or kind == "?DO" then
            local values = self:take(2, action.raw)
            if kind == "?DO" and values[1] == values[2] then
                pc = action.target
            else
                self:return_push(values[1], action.raw)
                self:return_push(values[2], action.raw)
            end
        elseif kind == "LOOP" or kind == "+LOOP" then
            local step = kind == "+LOOP" and self:take(1, action.raw)[1] or 1
            self:return_need(2, action.raw)
            local index, limit = self.returns[#self.returns], self.returns[#self.returns - 1]
            local next_index = index + step
            if (index - limit < 0) ~= (next_index - limit < 0) then
                table.remove(self.returns)
                table.remove(self.returns)
            else
                self.returns[#self.returns] = next_index
                pc = action.target
            end
        elseif kind == "LEAVE" then
            self:return_need(2, action.raw)
            table.remove(self.returns)
            table.remove(self.returns)
            pc = action.target
        elseif kind == "OF" then
            local values = self:take(2, action.raw)
            if values[1] ~= values[2] then
                self:push(values[1], action.raw)
                pc = action.target
            end
        elseif kind == "ENDCASE" then
            self:take(1, action.raw)
        else
            self:runtime_action(action, locals)
        end
    end
    for i = #self.returns, saved + 1, -1 do
        self.returns[i] = nil
    end
    self.depth = self.depth - 1
end
function Machine:execute(word, raw)
    while word.kind == "defer" do
        if not word.token then
            problem(raw, "deferred word not set", -21)
        end
        word = self:valid_token(word.token, raw)
        raw = word.name
    end
    if word.kind == "colon" then
        self:definition(word, 1, raw)
    elseif word.kind == "create" then
        self:push(word.address, raw)
        if word.does then
            self:definition(word.does, word.does_start, raw)
        end
    elseif word.kind == "variable" then
        self:push(word.address, raw)
    elseif word.kind == "constant" then
        self:push(word.value, raw)
    elseif word.kind == "value" then
        self:push(self.memory[word.address // 8 + 1], raw)
    else
        self:builtin(word.name, raw)
    end
end
local effects = {}
for _, entry in ipairs(
    {
        {2, "+ - * / MOD /MOD MIN MAX = <> < > AND OR XOR SWAP OVER NIP TUCK 2DUP 2DROP .R ! +!"},
        {3, "*/ */MOD WITHIN ROT -ROT"},
        {4, "2SWAP 2OVER"}
    }
) do
    for name in entry[2]:gmatch("%S+") do
        effects[name] = entry[1]
    end
end
function Machine:builtin(name, raw)
    if
        name == "CREATE" or name == "VARIABLE" or name == "CONSTANT" or name == "VALUE" or
            name == "DEFER"
     then
        local raw_name = self:read_name(raw)
        self:check_name(raw_name)
        local value = 0
        if name == "CONSTANT" or name == "VALUE" then
            value = self:take(1, raw)[1]
        end
        self.dictionary[#self.dictionary + 1] = {
            name = raw_name:upper(),
            raw_name = raw_name,
            kind = name:lower(),
            here = #self.memory * 8,
            address = #self.memory * 8,
            value = value
        }
        if name == "VARIABLE" or name == "VALUE" then
            self.memory[#self.memory + 1] = value
        end
        return
    elseif name == "'" then
        local target_name = self:read_name(raw)
        local target = self:lookup(target_name)
        if not target then
            problem(target_name, "undefined word", -13)
        end
        self:push(self:execution_token(target), raw)
        return
    elseif name == "EXECUTE" then
        self:execute_token(self:take(1, raw)[1], raw)
        return
    elseif name == "CATCH" then
        local token = self:take(1, raw)[1]
        local target = self:valid_token(token, raw)
        local saved, return_size, depth = copy(self.data), #self.returns, self.depth
        local ok, caught =
            pcall(
            function()
                self:execute(target, target.name)
            end
        )
        local code = 0
        if not ok then
            if type(caught) ~= "table" or not caught.forth or caught.code == nil then
                error(caught, 0)
            end
            self.data = saved
            for i = #self.returns, return_size + 1, -1 do
                self.returns[i] = nil
            end
            self.depth, code = depth, caught.code
        end
        self:push(code, raw)
        return
    elseif name == "THROW" then
        local code = self:take(1, raw)[1]
        if code ~= 0 then
            problem(raw, "exception " .. code, code)
        end
        return
    elseif name == "ABORT" then
        problem(raw, "aborted", -1)
    elseif name == "WORDS" then
        for i = #self.dictionary, 1, -1 do
            self:write(self.dictionary[i].name .. " ")
        end
        return
    elseif name == "CR" then
        self:flush()
        return
    elseif name == "SPACE" then
        self:write(" ")
        return
    elseif name == ".S" then
        local count, values = self:format(#self.data, raw), {}
        for i, value in ipairs(self.data) do
            values[i] = self:format(value, raw)
        end
        self:write("<" .. count .. "> ")
        for _, value in ipairs(values) do
            self:write(value .. " ")
        end
        return
    elseif name == "TRUE" then
        self:push(-1, raw)
        return
    elseif name == "FALSE" then
        self:push(0, raw)
        return
    elseif name == "BL" then
        self:push(32, raw)
        return
    elseif name == "BASE" then
        self:push(0, raw)
        return
    elseif name == "HERE" then
        self:push(#self.memory * 8, raw)
        return
    elseif name == "DEPTH" then
        self:push(#self.data, raw)
        return
    elseif name == "HEX" then
        self.memory[1] = 16
        return
    elseif name == "DECIMAL" then
        self.memory[1] = 10
        return
    end
    local values = self:take(effects[name] or 1, raw)
    local a, b = values[1], values[2]
    local function push(...)
        for _, value in ipairs({...}) do
            self:push(value, raw)
        end
    end
    if name == "+" then
        push(a + b)
    elseif name == "-" then
        push(a - b)
    elseif name == "*" then
        push(a * b)
    elseif name == "/" or name == "MOD" or name == "/MOD" or name == "*/" or name == "*/MOD" then
        local dividend, divisor = a, b
        if #values == 3 then
            dividend, divisor = a * b, values[3]
        end
        if divisor == 0 then
            problem(raw, "division by zero", -10)
        end
        local q = dividend // divisor
        local r = dividend - divisor * q
        if name == "MOD" then
            push(r)
        elseif name == "/MOD" or name == "*/MOD" then
            push(r, q)
        else
            push(q)
        end
    elseif name == "NEGATE" then
        push(-a)
    elseif name == "ABS" then
        push(math.abs(a))
    elseif name == "MIN" then
        push(math.min(a, b))
    elseif name == "MAX" then
        push(math.max(a, b))
    elseif name == "1+" then
        push(a + 1)
    elseif name == "1-" then
        push(a - 1)
    elseif name == "2*" then
        push(2 * a)
    elseif name == "2/" then
        push(a // 2)
    elseif name == "=" then
        push(flag(a == b))
    elseif name == "<>" then
        push(flag(a ~= b))
    elseif name == "<" then
        push(flag(a < b))
    elseif name == ">" then
        push(flag(a > b))
    elseif name == "0=" then
        push(flag(a == 0))
    elseif name == "0<>" then
        push(flag(a ~= 0))
    elseif name == "0<" then
        push(flag(a < 0))
    elseif name == "0>" then
        push(flag(a > 0))
    elseif name == "WITHIN" then
        push(flag(b <= a and a < values[3]))
    elseif name == "AND" then
        push(a & b)
    elseif name == "OR" then
        push(a | b)
    elseif name == "XOR" then
        push(a ~ b)
    elseif name == "INVERT" then
        push(~a)
    elseif name == "DUP" then
        push(a, a)
    elseif name == "?DUP" then
        push(a)
        if a ~= 0 then
            push(a)
        end
    elseif name == "DROP" or name == "2DROP" then
    elseif name == "SWAP" then
        push(b, a)
    elseif name == "OVER" then
        push(a, b, a)
    elseif name == "ROT" then
        push(b, values[3], a)
    elseif name == "-ROT" then
        push(values[3], a, b)
    elseif name == "NIP" then
        push(b)
    elseif name == "TUCK" then
        push(b, a, b)
    elseif name == "2DUP" then
        push(a, b, a, b)
    elseif name == "2SWAP" then
        push(values[3], values[4], a, b)
    elseif name == "2OVER" then
        push(a, b, values[3], values[4], a, b)
    elseif name == "PICK" or name == "ROLL" then
        if a < 0 then
            problem(raw, "invalid argument", -24)
        end
        if a >= #self.data then
            problem(raw, "stack underflow", -4)
        end
        local index = #self.data - a
        local value = self.data[index]
        if name == "ROLL" then
            table.remove(self.data, index)
        end
        push(value)
    elseif name == "." then
        self:write(self:format(a, raw) .. " ")
    elseif name == ".R" then
        local text = self:format(a, raw)
        self:write(string.rep(" ", math.max(0, b - #text)) .. text)
    elseif name == "?" then
        local address = self:address(a, raw)
        self:write(self:format(self.memory[address], raw) .. " ")
    elseif name == "EMIT" then
        if a < 32 or a > 126 then
            problem(raw, "invalid argument", -24)
        end
        self:write(string.char(a))
    elseif name == "SPACES" then
        if a > 0 then
            self:write(string.rep(" ", a))
        end
    elseif name == "!" then
        self.memory[self:address(b, raw)] = a
    elseif name == "@" then
        push(self.memory[self:address(a, raw)])
    elseif name == "+!" then
        local address = self:address(b, raw)
        self.memory[address] = self.memory[address] + a
    elseif name == "," then
        self.memory[#self.memory + 1] = a
    elseif name == "ALLOT" then
        if a < 0 or a % 8 ~= 0 then
            problem(raw, "invalid argument", -24)
        end
        for _ = 1, a // 8 do
            self.memory[#self.memory + 1] = 0
        end
    elseif name == "CELLS" then
        push(8 * a)
    elseif name == "CELL+" then
        push(a + 8)
    end
end
function Machine:process_line(line)
    self.line, self.position = line, 1
    local ok, caught =
        pcall(
        function()
            while true do
                local raw = self:read()
                if not raw then
                    break
                end
                self:process(raw)
            end
        end
    )
    if not ok then
        if type(caught) ~= "table" or not caught.forth then
            error(caught, 0)
        end
        if #self.pending > 0 then
            self:flush()
        end
        output[#output + 1] = "ERROR " .. caught.word .. ": " .. caught.reason
        self.data, self.returns, self.compiling, self.controls, self.depth = {}, {}, nil, {}, 0
    elseif #self.pending > 0 then
        self:flush()
    end
end

local machine = Machine.new()
for line in io.lines() do
    if line == "BYE" then
        if machine.compiling then
            output[#output + 1] =
                "ERROR " .. machine.compiling.raw_name .. ": unterminated definition"
        end
        break
    end
    machine:process_line(line)
end
if #output > 0 then
    io.write(table.concat(output, "\n"), "\n")
end
